newsitem.title: UK: BOC extends gain after trading statement.
newsitem.headline: BOC extends gain after trading statement.

text.p: Shares in BOC Group Plc rose in a weak UK equity market on Tuesday in continued reaction to last week's modestly upbeat trading statement and ahead of first-quarter results on February 20, dealers and analysts said.
The stock was up 14p at 909-1/2 by 1020 GMT in slim volume of 228,669 shares, even as the FTSE 100 index was down 18.4 points at 4,175.6.
Dealers said they were unaware of any specific factor driving BOC shares and market sources denied suggestions that analysts at SBC Warburg had commented on the stock.

Last week BOC chief executive Danny Rosenkranz told the company's AGM that exchange rate movements made it difficult to predict profits for the year though he expected 1997 to be a year of solid underlying progress.
